subject: [PATCH v3 02/11] scsi: mpt3sas: Hold event references while cleaning up the event queue

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the mpt3sas driver where event references are not held while cleaning up the event queue, leading to potential use-after-free errors and other issues. The patch addresses this by holding event references during cleanup, ensuring that events are not freed prematurely. It also introduces additional locking to prevent concurrent access and ensures that events are properly removed from the list before they can be requeued or canceled.
